title: Academic
name: Mortimer
description: The Academic is a respected professor of the University, precise and eloquent at his lectern and guarded everywhere else. He is kind, patient and cautious to a fault, a man who would rather keep a dangerous secret than confront it. Beneath the composure is guilt, and a fascination with what he fears, which he has never quite managed to give up.
history: The Academic was content with archaeology and ancient religion until he took a brilliant student under his wing, and the two of them began, in secret, to study the Iron Crown. When the library burned with their research inside, he was almost relieved, thinking it was over. Then an invitation from the Ancestor ended in a failed ritual and a dead cabal, and where he was horrified, his student was inspired. For a time he went on helping with the experiments, ever more reluctantly, until the two drifted apart and his protégé went home. Now he teaches by day, and by night searches for a way to undo what they began.
summary: A scholarly and guilt-ridden Academic, who studied the Iron Crown with his brightest student and now works by night to undo it.

appearance.features: Square spectacles, neatly trimmed beard, hands that tremble slightly when discussing certain topics

clothing.head: None
clothing.body: Shirtsleeves and a striped waistcoat, with a loosened tie
clothing.accessories: Pocket watch, leather satchel filled with notes, chalk-dusted fingers

notes: Speaks with eloquent precision, in ornate, alliterative sentences full of rare words that often leave simpler listeners bewildered
Keeps his research under strict secrecy, and grows sharp with anyone who pries
Never accepts that a student is too far gone, whether truant, failing or worse, and always believes one more conversation might bring them back
Maintains voluminous correspondence with scholars across the known world
